steps: Correspondence P-S, Q-R, R-Q gives ΔPQR ≅ ΔSRQ
Two sides and included angle: SAS (RHS needs hypotenuse-side, not used)
check_code:
# apply criteria: correspondence P->S,Q->R,R->Q ; known equal: PQ=SR (Q->R side), angle Q=angle R=90, QR=RQ
corr={'P':'S','Q':'R','R':'Q'}
def fits(tri1,tri2,crit):
    m=dict(zip(tri1,tri2))
    if m!=corr: return False
    # sides PQ=SR, QR=RQ and included angle at Q(=R) equal 90: SAS. RHS would need the right angle plus hypotenuse and a side; hypotenuses PR,SQ not given equal.
    return crit=='SAS'
opts=[('PQR','SRQ','RHS'),('PQR','SRQ','SAS'),('PQR','SQR','SAS'),('PQR','SQR','RHS')]
ok=[fits(*o) for o in opts]
assert ok==[False,True,False,False]
